abstain.description: True when the evaluator cannot reach a supported judgment and the correct behavior is to abstain rather than guess.

cleared_contradictions.description: Schema 1.3: contradictions carried from earlier rounds that this evaluation clears, each with its reason.

item_verdicts.description: Schema 1.3: one verdict for every objection under evaluation, the ones still open from earlier rounds and this round's. Empty on earlier records, which judged this round's items only, implicitly.

unresolved_items.description: Challenge ITEM ids the evaluator judges still unresolved. From schema 1.3 exactly the ids of the `unresolved` verdicts.

ClaimAssessment.description: Evaluator output: per-claim sufficiency judgment. Factual and relevance judgments live here; cryptographic integrity is reported separately in `EvidenceVerification` and is never inferred from this document.

contradicting_evidence.description: Evidence the evaluator judges to contradict this claim.

ClearedContradiction.description: A contradiction recorded in an earlier round that this evaluation judges no longer applies, with the reason (schema 1.3). Silence never clears a contradiction; only an entry here does.

ItemStatus.description: Evaluator judgment on one Critic objection (schema 1.3): `resolved` when the proposal as written no longer has the problem or the retrieved evidence shows the objection is mistaken; `unresolved` when it still applies, so it stays open into the next round.

ItemVerdict.description: One explicit verdict on one objection, by item id (schema 1.3).

reason.description: Why. Required (non-empty) for a resolved verdict: an objection is never closed without saying what settled it.
